Victoria Harbour, Canada36 contributions

Must eat here!
Mar 2026 • Couples
Swiss House is a great dinner location. Fantastic French/Swiss dishes and very good service. I highly recommend eating here. 

We shared the ham and Swiss raclette (#40) as a starter. It comes with a garden salad. It was a generous portion and very tasty. 

We shared the cast iron beef skillet with mushroom cream sauce (#105) for an entree, with fries, steamed rice, and veggies on the side. It was beautifully presented and the flavours were great. The beef came seared on the outside so you could cook it as rare as you like. 

For dessert, we enjoyed the Colonel Coupe (lemon sorbet, vodka, lime garnish) and Banana Flambé (with ice cream and an apple reduction). Both were absolutely delicious.

I Now Love Fondue
Mar 2025 • Couples
I had never tried fondue and I am now converted, we were recommended this by some French people we met so thought we would give it a try the fondue is delicious Im so happy I tried it, we also had the raclette burger which was cheeses heaven in fact all cheese dishes here are amazing, we have been in Mui Ne for quite a while and this is a definite go to restaurant. My only niggle is the children sometimes go a bit wild while carefree parents leave them to run around.
Insider tip:
The large fondue is a good starter for 2
